messages:
Emily: Opening a PR to refresh the Get-Started lab (first-time-run guide) — swap in the new SDK snippet, tighten up the auth section, and simplify the Docker instructions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345. Can @Samir and @Oli take a look?
Samir: On it. Quick Q: do we keep the raw curl example or migrate fully to SDK usage? A lot of folks still paste curl for quick smoke tests. :thinking_face:
Oli: I vote keep both, but make the SDK example primary. Also: add a short paragraph explaining env var mapping and show both patterns (env var -> sdk init). Docs style guide prefers one clear path + a short alternate.
Emily: agree — main flow: SDK init (JS + Py), secondary: curl. I'll add a tiny table mapping.
Samir: Found one tech snag — the old snippet used `REDWOOD_KEY` env var which no longer exists. We should standardize on `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and show the mapping for older users. Also CI flagged an invalid JSON blob in the example config.
Emily: good catch. I'll replace `REDWOOD_KEY` with `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere and fix the JSON. Proposed snippet to insert into the JS quickstart:
```javascript
// minimal JS example
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
Redwood.init({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await Redwood.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(res.text);
```
Samir: That looks fine. For the curl example, maybe show how to include the API key in a header and in an env var form:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk-REDACTED"
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"hi"}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Oli: Two small wording nits: 1) in the intro say "Get started in under 5 minutes" -> avoid absolute time claims; change to "Quickstart: start in minutes". 2) Replace "model: 'redwood-alpha'" with a parenthetical about model families so users don't think it's the only option.
Maria: Also add a note for Dedicated/Private customers: auth via customer-managed KMS or instance role may be preferred — link to the Dedicated deployment section. People in enterprise channels will ask.
CI-bot: /docs/lint — failure in PR 2345: code fences missing language identifier in two spots, and line-length warnings in the Dockerfile example.
Emily: pushing a fix now. I'll add language tags to all fences and wrap the Dockerfile lines. New commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9a7f1b2
Samir: Quick review of the updated diff — LGTM except one tiny piece in the auth table: the legacy env-var entry still mentions `REDWOOD_KEY` in the description.
Emily: fixed in 9a7f1b2 -> 3c4d5ef (pushed).
Oli: copy edits done. I trimmed a couple of sentences and added a short troubleshooting callout: "If you see 401, confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY set and not expired."
Maria: added the Dedicated note and linked the KMS doc. Also added a short sentence about rotating keys and where to find audit logs.
Samir: :white_check_mark: approving — tests passing on my side.
CI-bot: /docs/lint — all checks passed for PR 2345.
Emily: thanks everyone. I'll merge after the final CI run completes and then cherry-pick a tiny note into the v1.2 release notes. :rocket:
